description: This file is a shell script that performs diff-related testing, including setting up test scenarios, running diff commands with various options, and verifying output. It is part of a test suite for diff utilities, particularly focusing on word diff and color diff features.

methods.name: word_diff
methods.description: A shell function that performs a diff between two files, pre and post, by creating git objects for each, then executing 'git diff --no-index' with various options, decoding and comparing the output.

methods.name: test_language_driver
methods.description: A function that tests diff colorization and word diff features for a given language driver by copying expected files, setting attributes, and running word_diff with specific options.
